## Purpose
The single source of truth for constructing the LangChain chat-model client used by every agent graph, so provider selection (Anthropic / Bedrock / Mistral) and reliability tuning (timeouts, retries, extended thinking) live in exactly one place.

## Shape
- `build_model(model, *, max_tokens, provider)` — the main entry point; resolves a provider chain (explicit `provider="mistral"` override → `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` set → `BEDROCK_*` + `AWS_REGION` configured → `MISTRAL_API_KEY` fallback) and returns a configured `ChatAnthropic` / `ChatBedrockConverse` / `ChatMistralAI` instance.
- `ModelConfigurationError` — raised when no provider resolves.
- `_build_bedrock_bearer_session` — a boto3 session helper that bridges `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` from settings into the process env (botocore reads bearer-token auth from env, not from pydantic settings).
- `model_identifier(llm)` — best-effort extraction of a model id off any of the three client types (`.model_id`/`.model`/`.model_name`) for token-cost reporting.
- Extended-thinking handling — a shared `thinking_enabled`/`budget` computation applied identically to both the Anthropic and Bedrock branches when `THINKING_BUDGET_TOKENS > 0`.

## Why this shape
The module docstring states the explicit rationale: centralizing provider selection and Bedrock's reliability tuning (read timeouts, adaptive retries) in one function so every agent graph gets the same behavior instead of each call site reimplementing it; several inline comments also document specific incidents driving choices (e.g. `ChatMistralAI`'s 120s default timeout truncating long generations).
